name: Web forms and rich text editors

instructions.text: Check the field’s label, type, required flag, and displayed validation message. Use the expected format and allowed range; a value rejected by validation needs correction before submission.
A combobox may accept typed text or require choosing an option from a popup. After typing, inspect suggestions and select the matching observed option if the field still needs a committed selection.
Rich text areas can be editable page regions rather than input elements. Use the observed writable control and read its text back after filling or pasting; formatting may be retained by rich editors.

Use surrounding section labels to associate each field with the correct person or record. Fill one record’s matching fields before moving to another; identical field labels can belong to different sections.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed context check for repeated form sections; use observed relationships instead of guessed selectors.

instructions.text: Choose compose for a selected field when its text needs drafting. Provide the user goal, field context, and retained exact values to the helper; reuse known content instead of inventing a new version.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick Jev/text-helper role separation: Jev selects the field and the helper writes its text.

instructions.text: After a save or submit, check the resulting record or confirmation and any remaining validation errors. Wait for the relevant change when loading continues; inspect the result before retrying an uncertain submission.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed outcome check combining observed validation and fresh page state.
